authoredHypotheses.description: Informed‑flow fade: when smart wallets are net short YES (smart_flow_stance ≤ -1) on above‑strike one‑touch contracts with a positive sell‑YES edge, short the asset’s spot. The smart‑money selling on dips and high‑side YES is a reliable contrarian predictor of spot declines.

GOLD put/call extreme low short: when GOLD’s GLD put/call ratio falls into the bottom 10% of its 7‑day range (indicative of excessive call buying), short GOLD despite the positive trend. Previous positive‑trend filters incorrectly blocked this signal; the extreme low often precedes a corrective pullback.

PM‑IV rich NO fade: when Polymarket IV exceeds listed‑option IV by ≥10 vol points on an above‑strike one‑touch NO contract with a positive sell‑YES edge, short the asset. The rich premium on NO contracts points to overpriced downside protection that will compress as spot stabilises or drops modestly.

BTC one‑touch NO edge with moderate strength: when a BTC upside one‑touch NO contract offers a sell‑YES edge between 3 and 8 percentage points and the contract expires within 30 days, short BTC. This captures the cluster where the edge is large enough to compensate for the risk but not so extreme as to indicate a market dislocation that fails to revert.

Refinement of H‑534: Only take the gold one‑touch NO edge when the underlying spot is in a downtrend (below its 7‑day SMA) to avoid fading strong rallies. The cap edge alone is insufficient; a bearish regime context is needed for the mispricing to correct via spot decline.

Refinement of H‑539: Restrict CBRS funding reversion to true weekend days (Saturday and Sunday) and require funding deeper than ‑10% to isolate overshoots that rapidly normalise. This aligns with the strong weekend‑only performance seen in the broader WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG family.

Refinement of H‑537: Apply the same weekend‑only filter and a deeper threshold (<‑15%) to AAPL funding reversion. The evidence shows AAPL funding snap‑backs are concentrated on weekends; weekday signals are false reversals that continue the trend.

Refinement of H‑001: Shift from absolute PM‑IV thresholds to regime‑relative compression (PM IV below its 20th percentile of 30‑day range) and add an oversold filter (spot below 7‑day SMA) to time the expansion move. This captures genuine cheap‑vol regimes poised for breakouts instead of persistent low‑vol drifting.

Refinement of the cross‑asset IV compression long: add a Bitcoin funding extreme short condition (funding < ‑50%) to identify crowded shorts and require HYPE OI growth >3% to confirm genuine risk‑on capital inflow. This raises the bar for momentum confirmation significantly.
